# Fast3D renderer

This directory contains the MIT-licensed Fast3D interpreter and vitaGL backend
from DaedalusX64-vitaGL commit
`fb7238e2d4b3600e5e5c84986871be1396e337af`.

Upstream: https://github.com/Rinnegatamante/DaedalusX64-vitaGL

The adjacent Vita bridge converts N64Recomp's word-swapped guest RDRAM data
into the native-pointer ABI expected by this renderer. See `LICENSE.txt` for
the upstream license.
